bio.text: Don Tracy is a Springfield attorney and senior counsel at Brown, Hay & Stephens who won the Republican nomination for U.S. Senate in Illinois in 2026.
He chaired the Illinois Republican Party from 2021 until 2024, chaired the Illinois Gaming Board, and ran unsuccessfully for lieutenant governor in 2010.
